title: Learning beyond the classroom
prompt: Some people believe that practical skills should receive more attention than academic subjects at school. Others believe that academic subjects are more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Libraries in the digital age
prompt: Some people believe public libraries should spend more of their budgets on digital resources such as e-books and online courses. Others think libraries should prioritise printed books and physical study spaces. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Tourism in small towns
prompt: Some people believe small towns should attract more visitors because tourism creates jobs and supports local businesses. Others believe these towns should limit visitor numbers to protect residents' quality of life. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Homework in primary school
prompt: Some parents believe primary school children should receive regular homework to reinforce what they learn in class. Others think children of this age should spend their time after school playing or resting. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Public transport or better roads
prompt: Some people believe cities should spend more money improving public transport. Others believe the money should be used to improve roads for private vehicles. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Choosing a career
prompt: Some people believe young adults should choose a career based on their interests. Others think they should give more importance to job security and salary. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Local food in supermarkets
prompt: Some people think supermarkets should give priority to locally produced food. Others believe they should offer a wide range of imported food to give customers more choice. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Working from home or at the office
prompt: Some people believe employees should be allowed to work from home whenever their job permits. Others think employers should require staff to work at the office most days. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: Competitive sport in schools
prompt: Some people believe schools should organise competitive sports because competition teaches valuable lessons. Others think school sports should focus on participation and enjoyment rather than winning. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

title: The future of historic buildings
prompt: Some people think cities should preserve old buildings because they reflect local history. Others believe these buildings should be replaced when new housing or public facilities are needed. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
